summary: Comprehensive testing of InfoPilot Explorer iteration 6 completed. All 31 backend API tests passed (100%). All UI flows verified working correctly. CRITICAL NEW FEATURES VERIFIED: 1) Blocked words filter uses word boundaries - 'association', 'class', 'assistant', 'bass' all ALLOWED (contain 'ass' as substring), standalone 'ass' BLOCKED. 2) New social features (Friends, Groups, Pages) all working. 3) Admin auto-added as first friend for new users. 4) Protocol creation forms show case-insensitivity note. Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in /api/global-database endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in /api/global-database endpoint - added {'_id': 0} projection
Blocked words filter correctly uses word boundaries (regex \b) - allows 'association', 'class', 'assistant' while blocking standalone 'ass'
Social features (Friends, Groups, Pages) properly implemented with Facebook-like functionality
New user registration correctly adds admin as first friend
Category modals (create/edit) show case-insensitivity note: 'Capitalization doesn't matter - Science = science = SCIENCE'
seed_data_creation: Created test groups (public/private/secret), test pages (Business/Community), test users for friend verification - all cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features thoroughly tested and working. Key verifications completed: 1) BLOCKED WORDS: Word boundary matching works - 'association', 'class', 'assistant', 'bass' allowed, standalone 'ass' blocked. 2) FRIENDS: /api/friends returns list, new users get admin as first friend. 3) GROUPS: Create public/private/secret groups, view group detail with posts. 4) PAGES: Create pages with category selection, view page detail. 5) CATEGORIES: Case-insensitivity note shown in create/edit modals. 6) NAVIGATION: All sidebar items work (Command Center, InfoPilot Search, Ultimate Search, Categories, Friends, Groups, Pages, Intel Stats, Global Database, Book, Admin). 7) BOOK PAGE: 5 thumbnails in rotator, 19 Five-Star Reviews, purchase links. 8) ULTIMATE SEARCH: RENAME PAGE, Google Maps, AI Search all working.
